item.title: Mr. Softee’s America
item.description: On the eve of 2026’s snowmageddon, reaction crossed every segment of society. By Saturday, churches were closing. You would think we were in uncharted territory, even though it had been just five years since our last one foot plus snowfall. Greenland decided to throw its Arctic weather at us in a stealthy snow attack even the weather apps were bemused.

item.title: Rioting To Set Criminals Free – American Style Perversion?
item.description: Those who think the Bible is just a heap of moral platitudes and ancient religious practices, are surprised to learn that the Bible does say something about rioting, reveling, and rebellion. Let's look. “Let us walk honestly, as in the day; not in rioting and drunkenness, not in chambering and wantonness, not in strife and envying.” (Ro 13:13)

item.title: Media Brainwashing has Taken its Toll Upon Society
item.description: Media brainwashing today has reached an all-time high and has wrought irreparable damage throughout our nation and the world. Under the guise of bringing us the news the mainline media is bent on turning Americans against God and country by constantly barraging them with rebellious Marxist ideologies--ideologies that breed riots in our streets.

item.title: 'Lily White' Warned Me About Her Uninvited Doorbell Ringer
item.description: I was called today by a female friend who goes by 'Lily White.' She's also actively involved in community safety watch. This afternoon an uninvited door bell ringer climbed her stairs and rang the bell. He left after not getting a response.

item.title: Batman Becomes The Joker At Santa Clara Public Forum
item.description: Batman is a fictional character created by Bob Kane and Bill Finger. He first appeared in DC Comics' *Detective Comics #27 in May 1939. Known as the Caped Crusader, the Dark Knight, and the World's Greatest Detective, Batman is one of the most iconic fictional characters in the world. What sets him apart is that he is a superhero without any innate superpowers.

item.title: The Constitution Isn’t the Contradiction – The Left’s Logic Is
item.description: The Daily Show with Jon Stewart, the long-time flagship of progressive smugness, has once again convinced itself it uncovered a grand conservative contradiction. The show, once hosted by Stewart, then fumbled by Trevor Noah, and now dragged back to Stewart in a desperate attempt to resuscitate Comedy Central (which misplaced the “comedy” part years ago), thinks it landed a clever blow on the Second Amendment argument.

item.title: Minneapolis Mayor's Masterclass On Deception
item.description: Minneapolis Democratic chief executive gave a masterclass on deception during an interview with host Stephen A. Smith, who would've been a moderate Republican in another time. Minneapolis mayor Jacob Frey clashes with ICE, and the way forward (Straight Shooter With Stephen A.)

item.title: Poor nations won’t follow Europe, UN in economic suicide
item.description: Calling them wasteful and a threat to America’s sovereignty, freedoms and prosperity, President Trump pulled the United States out of 66 international organizations – most importantly the UN Framework Convention on Climate Change, the foundation for “climate crisis” treaties and policies.He also withdrew the US from the Paris climate agreement, vetoed US attendance at the 2025 COP30 climate conference, and revoked multiple costly regulations based on “climate crisis” claims.

item.title: Democrat Wins Show GOP Voters Are Not Motivated
item.description: On Saturday, Democrats easily won a special election for a State Senate seat in Texas. Their candidate, union leader Taylor Rehmet, defeated Republican activist Leigh Wambsganss by a stunning 14% margin. This election was particularly alarming for Republicans, since their candidate had been endorsed by President Donald Trump, who won the district in the 2024 election.

item.title: My Problem With Both Major Political Parties
item.description: My problem with the left is they only want me to accept their definition of 'progress' even where it doesn't generate progress for my community or the country. My problem with the right is it wants me to preserve a status quo that preserves structures stifling my community. Frankly, I'm not left, right, libertarian, socialist, democratic socialist nor capitalist. Decades of observation has me underwhelmed by application of these systems to date.
